verses.text: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
But the more I called to them, the more they went away from me. They offered sacrifices to the Baals and burned incense to carved idols.
It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms. But they did not realize it was I who healed them.
I led them with kindness and love, as with ropes. I was like someone who lifts a yoke from their neck. I bent down and fed them.
"They will not go back to Egypt, but Assyria will rule over them, because they refuse to turn back to me.
War will sweep through their cities. It will destroy the bars of their gates and put an end to their plans.
My people are determined to turn away from me. Even if they call to the Most High, he will not lift them up.
"How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is changed within me. All my tender love is stirred up.
I will not act on my fierce anger. I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a human being. I am the Holy One among you. I will not come against you in anger.
They will follow the LORD. He will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.
They will come trembling like birds from Egypt, like doves from Assyria. I will settle them in their homes again," says the LORD.
Ephraim surrounds me with lies, and the people of Israel with deceit. And Judah still wanders away from God, unfaithful to the Holy One.
